evidence.claim: No actual RAA execution: existing QuEra device lacks the needed AOD architecture. Fidelity is an analytical hardware-noise model; coherence scaled10x and gate error reduced10x to evaluate larger circuits. Equal qubit resources across architecture comparisons.

Low-degree well-localized circuits can favor FAA due to movement decoherence. Q-Pilot may have smaller depth while worse modeled fidelity.
Sensitivity exposes regime reversal: at two-qubit fidelity above0.9999, FAA/Geyser can beat RAA; movement speed and cooling thresholds have interior optima; architecture assumptions matter.

Cumulative mapper/router ablations: array mapping3.53x fidelity, additional atom mapping1.19x, router2.59x; combined10.9x modeled fidelity. These are cumulative controls, not exhaustive factorial identification.
Public artifact includes baselines and benchmarks; recommends8CPU cores/16GB RAM, <2h excluding Geyser which can take10h-day; no actual quantum hardware dependency.
